name: Guardian
description: Sends every consequential tool call to Guardian for an ALLOW / ASK / DENY decision before it runs. Deploys, destructive commands, messages and MCP calls wait for a person. Fails closed.

connectionId.description: Guardian record-only connection for everyday tools (Allow). Falls back to GUARDIAN_CONNECTION_ID.

askConnectionId.description: Guardian record-only connection for tools that need a person (Ask). Falls back to GUARDIAN_HOOK_ASK_CONNECTION_ID.

baseUrl.description: Guardian API base URL (https). Default https://guardian-api.odingard.com.

approvalTimeoutMs.description: How long an ASK waits for a person. Default and maximum 300000.

allowTierTools.description: Extra Guardian tool names (e.g. openclaw.tool_call) to send to the everyday connection.
